And Accenture's side of this tells the consulting story. They are building the capability to audit, certify, and de-risk AI at enterprise scale. That is not a side project — it is a defining service line for the next decade.

AI governance just moved from voluntary frameworks to funded infrastructure. The question for every executive team: does your AI strategy meet this new standard?
